info.title: Veronica Lens API
info.description: Veronica Lens API. Never share credentials or tokens entered in this interface.

get.summary: Check whether the API process is running

get.description: Calls Supabase Auth health with a 3 second timeout. Returns no URLs or error details.

post.description: A response does not prove that the email was previously unregistered.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
Sign in with a Google ID token
post.description: Send the ID token obtained by Google Sign-In on the device. If the token was requested with a nonce, send the raw nonce. A new account is created on the first sign-in.
Replace both stored tokens with the returned values. Avoid concurrent refresh requests for the same session.

post.summary: Sign out from the current session
post.description: Revokes refresh tokens for the current session only. Other sessions are not affected. Issued access tokens can remain valid until expiration. The application must also clear its local session.

204.description: Current session signed out; no response body

post.description: Returns a generic acknowledgement without confirming account existence. The redirect is configured by the server. This operation does not update the password.

enum: If the account exists, password recovery instructions were sent.

put.summary: Update the password of the authenticated user
put.description: Uses the session of the authenticated user; send the refresh token of the same session. Sessions expiring within 2 minutes are refused with AUTH_SESSION_REFRESH_REQUIRED: refresh the session and retry. Supabase password rules and reauthentication settings apply.

401.description: Missing, invalid or expiring session; refresh may be required

patch.description: Send only the fields to change. Latitude and longitude must be sent together, both numbers or both null. Use the avatar endpoints to change the avatar.

put.summary: Upload or replace the avatar image
put.description: Send the raw image bytes with the matching Content-Type (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB). The content is checked against the declared type. The stored URL changes on every upload.

400.description: Empty file or content does not match the type

503.description: Profile, storage or authentication service unavailable
Profile, storage or authentication service unavailable

delete.description: Irreversible. Removes observation media and avatar files, then the user; database rows are removed by cascade. Send {"confirmation": "DELETE"}. Issued access tokens remain valid until they expire; the app must clear its local session.

503.description: Account could not be deleted; try again later

get.description: Search is case- and accent-insensitive and matches id, name or aliases. Objects keep catalog order.

get.summary: Get a celestial object by id

post.summary: Locate catalog objects in the sky for an observer
post.description: Stars and constellations are computed locally from J2000 coordinates; the Moon and planets come from JPL Horizons. Unknown ids and provider failures are listed in `unavailable` instead of failing the request. The location is sent in the body so it does not appear in URLs or access logs.

400.description: Invalid input or observation time out of range

post.summary: Rise, transit and set times for the next 24 hours
post.description: Window of 24 hours from `from` (default now). Stars and constellations are computed analytically with standard refraction; the Moon and planets come from JPL Horizons at one-minute resolution. `horizon` tells whether the object crosses the horizon or stays above or below it. Unknown ids and provider failures are listed in `unavailable`.

400.description: Invalid input or window out of range

post.summary: Assess observing conditions for one instant
post.description: Weather from the closest forecast hour (Open-Meteo) and the Sun altitude at the exact instant. `at` defaults to now and accepts up to one hour in the past and seven days ahead. Factors and rating are codes; the app renders the text.

400.description: Invalid input or observation time out of range

post.summary: Assess observing conditions for the next seven days
post.description: Returns 168 hourly assessments starting at the next full hour (UTC).

400.description: Invalid input or observation time out of range

post.summary: Find the best window to observe one object
post.description: Samples the window every 15 minutes. A sample is favorable when the object is at or above `minimumAltitudeDegrees` and the conditions are not poor (darkness only when no weather forecast covers it). The recommended window is the longest favorable stretch. Windows last up to 24 hours, start at most one hour ago and end within one year.

400.description: Invalid input or window out of range

503.description: Object positions or authentication service unavailable

get.description: Published events curated in the database (eclipses, meteor showers, conjunctions). Returns events overlapping the range, including ongoing ones. `from` defaults to now and `to` to 90 days later; the range spans at most one year.

404.description: Event not found or not published

get.description: Published tracks in display order, with the caller progress summary. Tracks and lessons are read-only for users; progress is stored per user.

get.summary: Get a learning track with its lessons

404.description: Track not found or not published

get.summary: Get a lesson with its content and caller progress

404.description: Lesson not found or not published

put.summary: Save the caller progress for a lesson
put.description: Creates or replaces the caller progress. `in_progress` needs `progressPercent` from 1 to 99; `completed` sets 100 percent and a completion date; `not_started` resets the lesson.

404.description: Lesson not found or not published

put.summary: Register or refresh an Expo push token for the caller
put.description: Upserts the token as active. A token already bound to another user returns 409.

409.description: Token is already registered to another user

delete.summary: Remove an Expo push token of the caller
delete.description: Deletes the token row. A malformed or unknown token is a no-op, so the response is still 204.

post.summary: Send due astronomical event notifications (scheduled jobs only)
post.description: Requires `Authorization: Bearer <NOTIFICATIONS_DISPATCH_SECRET>`, not a user token. Sends to Expo for events within the next 30 days whose lead window has started. Each event and device pair is recorded once. `sent` means Expo accepted the message, not that it was delivered.

503.description: Dispatch is not configured or storage is unavailable

get.description: Newest first. Each observation includes signed URLs for its photos, valid for one hour. `hasMore` is true when another page exists.

delete.summary: Delete an observation and all of its photos

put.summary: Create or replace a photo of an observation
put.description: Send the raw image bytes with the matching Content-Type (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC or HEIF, up to 50 MB). The bytes are checked against the declared type. The capture metadata travels in the `x-veronica-observation` header as URL-encoded JSON, so the body stays binary.

parameters.name: x-veronica-observation
parameters.description: URL-encoded JSON with title, notes, capturedAt, optional astronomicalEventId, celestialObjectName, latitude, longitude, device and parameters.

400.description: Empty file, content does not match the type, or invalid metadata header

delete.summary: Delete one photo of an observation
delete.description: Removes the file first. If the observation has no photos left, the observation is deleted too, and `observationDeleted` is true.

magnitude.description: Apparent magnitude; null for moving or extended objects.

observedAt.description: ISO 8601 with offset, within one year from now. Defaults to now.

at.description: ISO 8601 with offset. Defaults to now.

weather.description: Null when the weather model has no value for that hour.

windowTo.description: After windowFrom and at most 24 hours later.

rejections.description: Samples failing each criterion; one sample may fail both.

type.description: Curated category, e.g. eclipse or meteor-shower.

from.description: Start of the 24-hour window, within one year from now. Defaults to now.

events.description: Ordered by time; a window may contain two transits.
